{{Top|leg}}
The '''Grig police department''' was responsible for patrolling the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Grig]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Narg]]. As dealing with most unlawful activities fell under the jurisdiction of the [[TransGalMeg Industries, Incorporated]] corporate guards, the responsibilities of the Grig police department revolved around keeping the native [[Nargan]]s peaceful. One of their main duties involved the confiscation of all weapons, such as [[Knife/Legends|knives]] and [[Axe/Legends|axes]] from the farmers. The majority of the Grig police department were recruited from the village police forces that had existed prior to TransGalMeg taking control of the planet.<ref name="Abduction">''[[The Abduction]]''</ref>
